seoTitle: How to Keep the Highlighter On in Google Docs (2026)
metaDescription: Lock the highlight tool in Google Docs using the Format Painter double-click trick so you can mark up multiple sections without reopening the color picker.
intro: Reopening the color palette for every single highlight slows down a thorough document review. This guide covers using the Format Painter's double-click shortcut to lock your highlighting style into a persistent tool state, letting you drag across multiple sections before releasing it with a simple key press.

steps.heading: Apply your initial highlight
steps.body: Select a block of text and use the Text Highlight tool from the toolbar to set your preferred color first.

steps.heading: Double-click the Format Painter icon
steps.body: Double-click the Format Painter tool icon to lock your highlighting style into a persistent, reusable state.

steps.heading: Drag across multiple sections
steps.body: With the tool locked, click and drag across sequential paragraphs to apply the same highlight repeatedly without reselecting the color.

steps.heading: Release the lock when finished
steps.body: Press the Escape key to instantly release the active brush style lock once your review pass is complete.

steps.heading: Organize colors by category
steps.body: Set up a consistent color map for different review categories, like questions versus key findings, to keep large team files organized.

faq.question: What is the trick for keeping the highlighter active without reselecting it each time?
faq.answer: Double-clicking the Format Painter icon locks your current highlight style so you can apply it repeatedly until you press Escape.

faq.question: Will the locked highlighter accidentally overwrite other text formatting?
faq.answer: It shouldn't, but it's worth double-checking your selections carefully since the Format Painter also carries other formatting attributes along with color.

faq.question: How do I stop the persistent highlighting tool?
faq.answer: Press the Escape key to release the lock and return to normal editing mode.

faq.question: Can I set up different colors for different review categories?
faq.answer: Yes, assigning specific colors to categories like edits, questions, or key data helps keep long team reviews organized and easy to scan.
